brief: Finds where an item occurs in a list, as positions: all, first, last, nth, the ones that differ, or those before or after a position.
detail: It is the search helper of stzList, which builds one over itself for its Find methods; build one with new stzListFinder when you only need to search. It never edits the list, so a stzList passed in stays intact. Positions are 1-based, and an absent item answers 0 for the single-position verbs and [ ] for the list verbs. Items are matched whole: a text, a number or a sublist, and Hebrew, Arabic and emoji texts match as one item each. Case counts unless you call the CS form with 0. The Next verbs look strictly after a position and count ranks forward; FindPreviousNthOccurrence counts ranks backward from the position, while FindPreviousNthOccurrences counts them forward from the start. Found today: AntiFind and AntiFindAsSections answer a wrong list for an empty list, and CountItemsW raises R14.
